comment: mkmaze.c movebubbles():1644 assigns the static water_pos to every square a bubble leaves, so each field of struct rm resets, waslit among them. A human Valkyrie in debug mode with !dark_room level-teleports with ^V to the Plane of Water (the menu's 'K' entry), wishes for nothing and searches for eight turns while the bubbles carry lit air she has seen away from her. #wizloadlua bigrm-2 then lays room floor over the level, and ^F maps it: display.c magic_map_background() draws an out-of-sight room square whose waslit is zero as the dark room symbol, blank with !dark_room. Seed 7730093 is the third of 7730061, 7730077 and 7730093 tried, the first whose bubbles leave such a square inside the room; date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
